The '''lettrani fruit tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keedad]],<ref name="CRO" /> which was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Keedad system/Legends|Keedad system]]</ref> and was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Keed]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. The tree had spiked [[Seed/Legends|seed]] pods that could bounce to great heights.<ref name="CRO" />

The seed pods of the lettrani [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] tree were picked and used in the [[lettranin]] game, in which the players flung them at the opposing team's members by using large scoops.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lettrani fruit tree was created by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" />
